gen-dafont-redux-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin stands tall, lowercase nearly touching the capitals, while Redux spaces its letters wide with a lightly engraved brass look. Paragraphs of it would run steady and open.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-anek-malayalam: Contemporary and geometric, Redux spreads wide with big curved entrances. Anek Malayalam sits beneath, its caps barely taller than lowercase and curve tips never touching, plain sans to its core.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-blinker: Redux swells gently on its curves and spaces its letters wide, with large lowercase and generous entrances into each bowl. Blinker, a sans-serif, holds every curve at full thickness and reads easily.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-mada: Big, inscribed, spread out: Redux carries the slight heft shifts of carved stone and a large entrance into every curve. Mada, a sans-serif with a towering midzone, keeps curves unclosed beneath it.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-mozilla-text: Spaced out and contemporary, Redux draws with a gently used dip pen. Mozilla Text, a sans with tall bodies and flared terminals, gives long lines a bold-looking, sturdy texture.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Modern in feel, Redux sets wide spacing and an enlarged lowercase, with modest contrast you notice only up close. Noto Sans Balinese, a plain sans, is all breathing room inside its curves.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Clean curves leave daylight like a rope's open bight in Noto Sans Sunuwar, set beneath the wide, lightly contrasted Redux. Short ascender stems keep the sans compact and friendly.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Noto Sans Syriac reads friendly, its tall bowls like blown glass bulbs. Redux, with thin strokes about half the weight of its thick ones, spaces wide above, and the sans below takes wide, easy turns in its s shapes.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Noto Sans Tagalog is mostly middle zone, plain sans with generous gaps. Redux, wide-spaced with the modest contrast of lightly engraved brass, supplies the display voice up top, leaving the body to hum along underneath.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Redux stretches its spacing wide, with big curved entrances and a mild stress that leaves every stroke solid. Beneath, Noto Sans Tamil, a sans-serif, looks magnified with terminals far from stems.
